answer: Latency-bonded task auction.** Each identity must win work by bidding against a latency curve and posting a refundable deposit that unlocks only after N completed tasks in a shared falcon queue. Clones start with zero completed tasks, so they sit at the slow end of the grove of priority tiers and must idle through a mandatory warm-up window before earning. A single lotus token of deposit is forfeited per skipped or failed task, pricing every clone at a fixed loss before it ever reaches parity.
